purpose: Certify every published Museum metric before calculation.

metrics.scope: Certified career wins from explicit modern awards and verified honours-board winners.
One certified runner-up finish per canonical Museum player per competition event, for finishing position exactly 2.
One certified Top 3 finish per canonical Museum player per competition event, for numeric finishing positions 1 to 3.
One certified Top 10 finish per canonical Museum player per competition event, for numeric finishing positions 1 to 10.
One certified Museum-player appearance per canonical player per included competition event.

Separate certified career averages for individual Medal nett scores, derived 18-hole gross scores using the historical handicap recorded on the same certified Medal result row, and individual Stableford points.

policy.derivedGrossCareerAverage: 18-hole Gross Average derived only from certified individual Medal nett rounds where a valid historical handicap is recorded on the same result row
policy.stablefordAverage: Individual Stableford scoring rounds using valid Stableford points only
